units: <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 7:11:1">Cant. R. to VII, 11</cite> (ref. to <he>תשוקתו</he>, <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 7:11:1">ib.</cite>) <he>שלשה שוקין הן אין שׁוּקָן של ישראל וכ׳</he> there are three kinds of desires: Israel longs for none but for his father in heaven; <he>אין שׁוּקָהּ של אשה וכ׳</he> woman’s desire is for her husband; <he>אין שׁוּקוֹ של יצר וכ׳</he> the evil temptation longs for Cain and the like of him; <he>אין שׁוּקָן של גשמים וכ׳</he> the rains desire the earth (ref. to <he>ותשקקה</he>, <cite ref="Psalms 65:10">Ps. LXV, 10</cite>); v. <cite ref="V01077"><he>תְּשׁוּקָה</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 117:4">Midr. Till. to Ps. CXVII</cite> (expl. <he>ותשקקה</he>, v. supra) <he>תן לה שׁוּקָהּ</he> ed. Bub. (oth. ed. <he>תשוקתה</he>) grant to her that for which she (the earth) longs.—Pl. <he>שׁוּקִין</he>, v. supra.
